mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_erp_distribution_after_sales (dist_order_id, dist_order_no, source_order_id, source_order_sn, owner_id, seller_id, product_id, product_name, reason, refund_amount, max_amount, status, apply_time, warehouse_time, distributor_time, finish_time, warehouse_remark, distributor_remark, reject_count, auto_flag, source_type) VALUES (#{distOrderId}, #{distOrderNo}, #{sourceOrderId}, #{sourceOrderSn}, #{ownerId}, #{sellerId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{reason}, #{refundAmount}, #{maxAmount}, #{status}, #{applyTime}, #{warehouseTime}, #{distributorTime}, #{finishTime}, #{warehouseRemark}, #{distributorRemark}, #{rejectCount}, #{autoFlag}, #{sourceType, jdbcType=INTEGER})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_erp_distribution_after_sales WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = '0'
SELECT * FROM t_erp_distribution_after_sales WHERE dist_order_id = #{distOrderId} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT * FROM t_erp_distribution_after_sales WHERE dist_order_id = #{distOrderId} AND status IN (0,1,2) AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM t_erp_distribution_after_sales WHERE seller_id = #{sellerId} AND status = 0 AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY apply_time ASC, id ASC
